assignment.order: Ascending SHA256 of canonical JSON {namespace,task_key,group_digest}; group_digest tie-break
assignment.quotas: Largest remainder with integer weights 8,1,1; ties train,validation,test
assignment.unit: trajectory component, not episode, frame or visual variant

grouping.additional_conservative_edge: Identical complete action sequence, regardless of state
grouping.closure: Connected components of exact, action-only and near edges; transitive
grouping.cross_task_component: Abort if any component spans canonical tasks
grouping.exact_identity: SHA256 of canonical full float32 state/action arrays, with shapes
grouping.group_digest: SHA256 of split_id, task_key and sorted distinct state_action digests
grouping.near_identity: Equal-length sequences; all raw state and action components differ by at most absolute tolerance, rtol=0; identical gripper sequence

limitations: Same 40 tasks; tests trajectory generalization, not unseen tasks
Near check covers equal-length aligned sequences only, not trims, shifts or time warps
Grouping does not prove independent simulator scenes or eliminate all semantic duplicates
source_scope: All 14347 episodes at the pinned Sylvest snapshot; old test arrays read only for structural grouping, not policy evaluation

usage.initialization: Pinned base Qwen3.5-2B plus fresh trainable modules/LoRA and optimizer; no B0-derived policy, optimizer, teacher or distilled targets
usage.old_models: v2 validation/test are not unseen data for existing B0 or its continuations
usage.selection: Future experiment must predeclare checkpoints and rollout-based decisions; this split does not define a training recipe or acceptance rule
usage.statistics: Fit all action and state normalization on v2 train only
usage.test: Lock after structural verification; no model scoring or tuning until final predeclared evaluation
usage.validation: Descriptive supervised diagnostics; report task macro averages, then equal trajectory-group means within task, equal variant means within group and equal valid-chunk means within episode; also report micro totals
